name: UpdateAttachment
label: Update Salesforce Attachment
description: Updates an existing Attachment record in Salesforce.

fields.name: Credential
fields.label: Credential to Connect With
fields.description: The Salesforce connection credential to use for authentication.

fields.name: AttachmentId
fields.label: Attachment ID
fields.description: The Salesforce ID of the Attachment to update (required).

fields.name: FieldUpdates
fields.label: Field Updates
fields.description: A dictionary of fields to update on the Attachment (e.g., Name, Description).

fields.name: Response
fields.label: Response
fields.description: The raw JSON response returned by Salesforce after updating the attachment.
